title: HiSTOR: Structured Treatment-outcome Representation Learning for High-Dimensional Longitudinal Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.17739v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating potential outcomes under alternative treatment sequences is essential for personalized decision-making, but remains challenging with high-dimensional covariates and time-varying confounding. In this study, we propose HiSTOR (High-dimensional Structured Treatment-Outcome Representation), an end-to-end framework that integrates nonlinear dimension reduction with longitudinal counterfactual prediction. The central idea is to learn structured low-dimensional representations of both current patient states and evolving histories, according to their shared and distinct relationships with treatment assignment and outcomes. This extends latent-space covariate adjustment to longitudinal settings, jointly addressing covariate dimensionality and historical complexity. translated_title: HiSTOR：面向高维纵向数据的结构化治疗-结局表示学习
translated_abstract: 在替代治疗序列下估计潜在结局对于个性化决策至关重要，但在高维协变量和时变混杂存在的情况下仍具挑战性。在本研究中，我们提出了HiSTOR（高维结构化治疗-结局表示），这是一个端到端框架，将非线性降维与纵向反事实预测相结合。其核心思想是根据当前患者状态与演变历史在治疗分配和结局方面所呈现的共有与特有关系，学习二者的结构化低维表示。该方法将潜空间协变量调整扩展到纵向场景，同时解决了协变量维度和历史复杂性问题。所得框架支持在指定治疗序列下进行一步和多步结局预测。在CVSim和CancerSim上的实验证明了其优越性能。
tldr: 提出了HiSTOR端到端框架，通过学习患者当前状态与演变历史的结构化低维表示，将非线性降维与纵向反事实预测相结合，在高维协变量和时变混杂下实现指定治疗序列的个性化结局预测。
en_tdlr: HiSTOR is an end-to-end framework that integrates nonlinear dimension reduction with longitudinal counterfactual prediction by learning structured low-dimensional representations of patient states and histories, enabling personalized outcome prediction under specified treatment sequences despite high-dimensional covariates and time-varying confounding.
